published_as: GitHub Release v1.9.2 only (APK above GitHub's 100 MiB file limit); Release SHA-256 identical to the local build (CI re-run after a transient D8 OutOfMemoryError)
changes: Owner-reported force close on «Otras coronillas»: not reproducible under Robolectric (4 identities, light/dark, ES/PT, 130 %, accessibility options, Android 16, Orar row and «Otras ▾» segment, real assets and images). Hardening: bundled images decode two at a time and chaplet catalogue thumbnails decode at 144 px instead of 240 px.
Uncaught crashes are now recorded in the local error report (exception and cause class names and up to 40 frames; never messages or personal text), so 'Send error report' carries the failing line.
tests: 171/171 on the affected areas (chaplets, Rosary, error report, navigation, Saints, devotions) plus new OtherChapletsEntry* and CrashRecorderFormatTest.
known_limitations: Not tested on a physical phone; the crash fix is unconfirmed until the owner retries.
